name: Athear
source:
Hobby: Playing chess

gentle, solemn, sophisticated. Athear is Dornick's master during her stay in Underwater Laboratory. Very little is known about this mysterious girl aside from the fact that her body functions in a very unusual way. Athear likes to fall asleep at random places and she is fond of places that remind her of the sea.
